writer_route: native GitHub write fallback after MarcoPolo transport corruption
notes: The initial MarcoPolo write created issue #47 with a corrupted body. An authorized native GitHub fallback repaired the body and an independent MarcoPolo read-back verified the final remote state. Ace saved the relation graph, but the tool did not expose canonical graph bytes, so the relation-map digest remains UNKNOWN rather than being reconstructed after the fact.
